correctness.rationale: With D=diag(1,1,η), stationarity makes the current J divergence-free; in the full even-coordinate entropy rate ∫J·D⁻¹J/p, the stationary log-density gradient and the equilibrium drift gradient drop out upon integration. This leaves η⁻¹∫fJ_z=V/η−E[fZ]; f is independent of z, so the axial density derivative integrates to zero. For the integration steps one can condition the stationary axial convolution on the current transverse state v: the backward OU history is e^(−u)v plus Gaussian noise, and Z is the resulting random smooth mean plus independent standard Gaussian noise. Polynomial bounds on the mean and its derivatives give finite score moments (conditional Jensen), as well as a polynomial bound on |log p| by Jensen on the Gaussian mixture. These justify integration with cutoffs. Stationary convolution gives E[fZ]=∫₀^∞e^(−ηu)E[f_u f_0]du. The squared transverse radius divided by two has Exp(1) law and generator 2s∂²+2(1−s)∂, so the centered Laguerre modes have eigenvalues −2m. The entropy weights are therefore 2m/[η(η+2m)], a bounded multiplier on L²; the calculation extends from finite sums. Strict increase gives the unique quadratic mode (4c²=V), and the difference of the second and first weights is 2/[(η+2)(η+4)], with equality exactly on modes 1 and 2 (transverse degrees 2 and 4). Each weight is strictly below 1/η and they converge to it; admissible normalized polynomial modes prove nonattainment and sharpness. The supplied checker’s generator recurrence follows by applying the joint generator to ZS^k; the reported finite checks were inspected as evidence, not rerun or relied on for the theorem.
residual_risks: The analysis is for the full three-coordinate even-variable process with the displayed diffusion matrix. It does not identify the rate from partially observed data or claim experimental realizability.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The optimization can be derived using established tools, but it requires reducing the full current functional in this triangular model to a force autocorrelation and identifying the radial spectrum of the resulting filter. No such statement was established in the inspected sources.
